data.raw_text: #China strongly condemns the malicious dissemination of false information concerning China and the wanton smearing of China’s image by Jay Tarriela, a spokesperson of the Philippine Coast Guard, and has lodged a strong protest with the #Philippine side, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said on Monday in response to a Global Times inquiry regarding Tarriela’s social media post claiming “Why China remains to be bully.” The inquiry also mentioned that on January 16, the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines lodged a protest, criticizing the relevant post for attacking and smearing Chinese leader, severely damaging China's political dignity, calling it a blatant political provocation that has crossed a red line. The embassy also expressed strong indignation to the Office of Philippine President, the Department of Foreign Affairs and the Philippine Coast Guard.
